summary: Increment B — Sicon read-side dashboard + endpoints tested end-to-end on the live preview. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests pass (dashboard shape, conflicts empty, api-health not-configured, preview/sync 400 not-configured, non-manager 403, unauth 401/403). Frontend: SiconDashboard renders cleanly in the 'not configured / disconnected' state — 'Not configured' + 'Read-only' badges present, all 4 equipment stat cards show 0, Preview/Sync buttons DISABLED with 'Configure the connection first' helper, Refresh + API Health buttons work without JS crash, API Health card shows 'Not configured.', empty Conflicts (0) card renders. HOWEVER: the Settings dialog that hosts the Sicon section is NOT reachable via the live UI header — Navbar destructures `_onOpenSettings` (underscore-prefixed = intentionally unused) so DashboardPage's `onOpenSettings` prop is never consumed and no header button opens the dialog. Testing agent added a small `?settings=1` query-param opener in DashboardPage.js to unblock UI verification.

ui_bugs.issue: Settings dialog (hosting Sicon Dashboard sub-tab) is not reachable from the dashboard header. Navbar.js:21 destructures `_onOpenSettings` (unused) while DashboardPage.js:218 passes `onOpenSettings`. There is no header/menu button that flips `showSettingsDialog=true`. Only the ?settings=1 query-param path (added by tester) or the deprecated Account modal preferences section reach it. Users cannot navigate to Settings → Sicon → Dashboard through the UI as described in the spec.

action_items: Restore a header/menu opener for the org Settings dialog (or remove the underscore prefix in Navbar destructuring and wire a visible Settings button/menu item). Alternatively bake in a permanent ?settings=<section> deep-link handler and add a menu item that uses it.
Optional: expose a dedicated `settings-open-btn` data-testid so this flow is testable via UI without query params.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/sicon.py read-side handlers are clean: correct role gating via _require_owner_or_manager, correct 400 on not-configured for preview/sync, dashboard/conflicts/api-health return the documented shape.
SiconDashboard.js correctly disables Preview + Sync buttons when !conn.configured and surfaces the helper prompt — good UX.

Navbar.js `_onOpenSettings` prop-name mismatch with DashboardPage.js caller is the reason Settings is orphaned from the UI (iter202 comment says it was moved to Account modal, but Account modal does not render SettingsTab — only user profile sections).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend read-side endpoints (GET /api/sicon/read/dashboard, /conflicts, /api-health; POST /equipment/preview, /equipment/sync) are green and correctly gated. UI SiconDashboard renders correctly in not_configured state. Only outstanding action is wiring a UI entry-point to the SettingsTab dialog so end-users can reach Settings→Sicon→Dashboard without ?settings=1 URL. The ?settings=1 query-param handler added by the tester in DashboardPage.js is a safe permanent addition and can stay.
rca of the issue: Iter202 commented that Settings was 'moved to Account modal' and Navbar's `_onOpenSettings` prop was renamed to indicate it's unused. However DashboardPage still passes `onOpenSettings` and still renders the full SettingsTab (which is the ONLY host for the Sicon integration UI including the new Dashboard sub-tab). AccountSettingsModal does NOT render SettingsTab. Net effect: SettingsTab (and therefore Sicon integration) has no UI entry-point. Mitigation: added `?settings=1` deep-link in DashboardPage.js:139-141 so the dialog auto-opens; long-term fix is restoring a Settings menu item that calls the passed `onOpenSettings` handler (rename `_onOpenSettings` → `onOpenSettings` in Navbar and wire a menu button).
